question: An artifact says 'Whenever a creature dies, you gain 1 life.' Two creatures are on the battlefield, and a spell destroys all artifacts, creatures and enchantments. Does the artifact's ability trigger for each creature even though the artifact is destroyed at the same time?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it triggers twice, even though the artifact goes to the graveyard at the same time as the creatures.
expected.answer: Two creatures are on the battlefield along with an artifact that has the ability “Whenever a creature dies, you gain 1 life.” Someone casts a spell that destroys all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments. The artifact’s ability triggers twice, even though the artifact goes to its owner’s graveyard at the same time as the creatures.

whyHard: Players think the artifact is gone before the creatures die, so it cannot see them.
